key.name: gather-shortcut
key.summary: Gather windows to the screen under the pointer
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that pulls every window onto the monitor the mouse is currently on.

key.name: undo-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that sends windows back to the monitors, sizes and states they had before the last gather.

key.name: scope
key.description: Whether to gather windows from every workspace or only from the workspace currently in view. Windows always keep the workspace they are on.

key.name: include-dialogs
key.description: When off, only ordinary application windows are moved and dialogs are left where they are.
